title: Functional Blocks
description: This mod contains 1 block, 2 items and a secret block that can be only obtainable by creative.
body:
The Functional Blocks Mod adds intriguing new features to the game, including epic blocks, items, and secrets to uncover. This mod encourages players to explore, test, and discover  impressive mechanics hidden within the game.

Features:

The Dot (Block):

A mysterious block with a secret function (you’ll have to figure it out!).
Can only be obtained using the Antidot item.
Antidot Item:

A key item used to acquire the Dot Block in your inventory.
Craftable using resources from both the Overworld and the End.
New Flower:

Found in the End and a special biome in the Overworld.
Essential for crafting the Antidot.
Secret Block:

A highly functional, exclusive block obtainable only in Creative mode. Its purpose is a mystery waiting to be revealed!
Environment Information:

Client and Server-Side Compatibility:
This mod requires installation on both the client and server, as it adds new blocks, items, and crafting recipes.
Why Should You Download?
Dive into the world of mystery with this mod! Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and add a layer of intrigue to your Minecraft adventures. Perfect for explorers, tinkerers, and those who love surprises.

Start your journey into the unknown with the Functional Blocks Mod today!
